name: Buska Public API
description:
Buska's public REST API for social-listening + B2B lead generation. Search mentions across 19 platforms, score posts for buyer intent with Buska AI, and retrieve qualified buying signals detected for your team.

All endpoints require an `x-api-key` header. Get yours from https://app.buska.io/settings (API tab). Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per API key. A two-tier billing applies: monthly subscription quota first, pay-as-you-go credits as fallback.
